items.title: Portugal moves to block Polymarket after large bets placed before presidential election results
items.content_text: - **Portugal moves to block Polymarket after large bets placed before presidential election results** — Portugal's gambling regulator SRIJ says Polymarket operates illegally in the country, where betting on political events is prohibited, and is moving to have internet providers block the platform after it stayed accessible past a 48-hour notice. More than 4 million euros was wagered shortly before the presidential results were known, with total volume on the main market passing 120 million dollars and the leading candidate's odds rising sharply ahead of official projections. ([BitRss](https://bitrss.com/portugal-cracks-down-on-polymarket-following-suspicious-election-betting-activity-174823))

items.content_text: - **Czech Republic blocks Kalshi from October 15, months after blocking Polymarket** — The Czech Ministry of Finance listed Kalshi as an unauthorised gambling operator on September 30, requiring internet providers to block it by October 15, after Polymarket was blocked in July 2026. Both platforms are now blocked or under active enforcement in at least six European jurisdictions, where regulators treat prediction market sports contracts as gambling regardless of their US regulatory status. Users can browse and trade supported Polymarket event markets directly in the KuCoin app with USDT settlement, while Polymarket provides the markets, prices, liquidity and result determination. ([KuCoin](https://www.kucoin.com/blog/why-prediction-markets-are-crypto-next-big-business-line))

items.title: Kalshi inflation trader Brian Golden beats Wall Street forecasters with over 2 million dollars made
items.content_text: - **Kalshi inflation trader Brian Golden beats Wall Street forecasters with over 2 million dollars made** — Brian Golden, a 44-year-old former theater director trading from Los Angeles, has become the most successful trader in Kalshi markets on economic indicators such as inflation. Bloomberg Law reports he has made over 2 million dollars on the platform. ([Bloomberg Law](https://news.bloomberglaw.com/banking-law/screenwriter-beats-wall-street-on-inflation-bets-from-his-garage))

items.title: Prediction markets favor Democrats for the House and Senate ahead of the 2026 midterms
items.content_text: - **Prediction markets favor Democrats for the House and Senate ahead of the 2026 midterms** — As of Tuesday, Polymarket gave Democrats a 91 percent chance of winning the House and a 64 percent chance of taking the Senate. Kalshi also listed a Democratic sweep as the leading balance-of-power outcome, with its individual markets favoring Democrats in Texas, Maine and Ohio and Republicans in Iowa. ([NorthJersey.com](https://www.northjersey.com/story/news/2026/10/13/who-will-win-2026-midterms-winning-midterm-elections-latest-polls-odds-predictions-polymarket-kalshi/92232625007/))

items.title: Kalshi and Polymarket midterm markets face insider-trading scrutiny over knowable contracts
items.content_text: - **Kalshi and Polymarket midterm markets face insider-trading scrutiny over knowable contracts** — An Anti-Corruption Data Collective analysis reported by CNN found more than 20 million dollars traded on highly specific midterm contracts, such as candidate withdrawals and rally remarks, and flagged correlated trades on a Kalshi contract about Graham Platner withdrawing from the Maine Senate race before a scandal became public. ([Bonus](https://www.bonus.com/news/midterm-prediction-markets-draw-insider-trading-scrutiny-as-kalshi-polymarket-expand-elect/))
